label: Seriality plus identity-admissible root collapse forces self-access
meaning: A direct constructive mathematical test for D serial frames and explicit proposition domains, not a source claim, transcription, frontier closure or refutation of Hume. Apply the shared identity-separation or extensional-separation theorem to a successor supplied by seriality. Substitute equality to obtain self-access; conversely singleton successors preserve every true predicate. Explicit existential witnesses establish nonvacuity, and two contrary possibilities contradict successor identity.
